name: Oliver Allen
source:
Likes: Dancing, singing, theater, being surrounded by people
Dislikes: Being teased or despised

Sweet and shy. Easily embarrassed. Well-liked, but curt when somebody flirts with him.

Has a short temper when he feels that someone is messing around with him.
